teaching_notes.review_principle: Detect silent resolution of contradictory route descriptions. A candidate must not delete one source-side relation merely because the remaining description appears more plausible.
teaching_notes.why_this_case_matters: The source contains both 'on your right' and 'on your left' around the glass-window description. The candidate retains only the left-side relation, which is an unsupported semantic choice.
teaching_notes.reusable_rule: If conflicting orientation language belongs to an auxiliary landmark and another stable cue uniquely identifies the route target, preserve the conflict as uncertainty and keep the stable target. If the conflict controls route choice, request review instead of guessing.
teaching_notes.anti_pattern: Do not spread a local defect to unrelated coverage rows or unchanged boundaries. Check the actual source and candidate, not the diagnostic label.
teaching_notes.case_specific_focus: The candidate silently resolves the conflicting auxiliary window-side description to the left. The unsupported auxiliary relation may alter orientation; the stable open-door/agent-right-bench identity and prior route are not separately broken.
